messages.message: Hello Nexora team, does Business Hosting support Node.js apps or only static HTML/CSS/JS and PHP?

Hi Vikramaditya! Business Hosting natively runs static web apps (HTML, CSS, JS, Vite dist builds) and PHP 8.2+. For full Node.js background services, our Advanced Hosting (₹5,000/yr) includes dedicated Node.js and PM2 cluster support.
Understood, thank you! I will deploy the React Vite production build as static HTML/JS for now.
